# Design System — components (brand: meridian-atlas-ui)
> GENERATED by @ds/context — DO NOT EDIT. Source hash sha256:b95446232cde065d. Regenerate: pnpm --filter @ds/context build

This system is closed-world: every legal component is enumerated in registries/components-index.json and every legal token in registries/tokens-index.json. Anything not in those registries is provably fabricated — do not emit it.

All 4 exports below come from `@ds/react` (the only public entry point). Props tables are generated from the code registry and are exact — including literal-union types.

## Banner

Import: `import { Banner } from '@ds/react';`

Atlas status banner. Untyped legacy JavaScript — no prop contract at all; `tone` is one of info | danger | warning | success by convention only.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tone` | `any` | yes | — |  |

@example
```tsx
<Banner />
```

## Button

Import: `import { Button } from '@ds/react';`

Atlas push button. Renders a native `<button>` with the `.atlas-btn` class family from styles/atlas.css.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Disables the control. |
| `onClick` | `() => void` | no | — | Click handler. |
| `size` | `"sm" \| "md" \| "lg"` | no | `md` | Control size. |
| `variant` | `"primary" \| "secondary" \| "danger"` | no | `primary` | Visual style of the button. |

@example
```tsx
<Button size="sm" variant="primary" />
```

Ground-truth stories: `packages/react/src/components/Button/Button.stories.tsx`, `packages/react/src/components/Dialog/Dialog.stories.tsx`, `packages/react/src/components/Tooltip/Tooltip.stories.tsx`, `src/components/Button.stories.tsx`

## Card

Import: `import { Card } from '@ds/react';`

Atlas content card — bordered, raised surface (`.atlas-card`).

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `padded` | `boolean` | no | `true` | Apply the default inner padding. |
| `title` | `string` | no | — | Optional heading rendered at the top of the card. |

@example
```tsx
<Card />
```

Ground-truth stories: `packages/react/src/components/Card/Card.stories.tsx`

## Input

Import: `import { Input } from '@ds/react';`

Atlas text input with a stacked label. Loosely typed on purpose — the props type is inline and `type` is an open string.

Static component (no react-aria-components base) — plain semantic HTML.

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `error` | `string` | no | — | Error message; when set the input gets the error border. |
| `label` | `string` | yes | — | Visible label rendered above the control. |
| `onChange` | `(value: string) => void` | no | — |  |
| `type` | `string` | no | — | Native input type (free-form string — legacy API). |
| `value` | `string` | no | — |  |

@example
```tsx
<Input label="…" />
```


# Design System — tokens (brand: meridian-atlas-ui)
> GENERATED by @ds/context — DO NOT EDIT. Source hash sha256:b95446232cde065d. Regenerate: pnpm --filter @ds/context build

This system is closed-world: every legal component is enumerated in registries/components-index.json and every legal token in registries/tokens-index.json. Anything not in those registries is provably fabricated — do not emit it.

44 tokens. Values below are RESOLVED for the `meridian-atlas-ui` brand (source: examples/legacy-ds-retrofit/brand/meridian-atlas-ui.json); a different brand build re-emits this file with its own values. Reference tokens only as `var(--ds-…)` — never paste resolved values into code.

Tier rules: semantic tokens (intent-named) are the general vocabulary; component tokens (`--ds-<component>-*`) are theming hooks that belong to their component ONLY — never borrow another component's hooks. Space tokens are legal only in margin/padding/gap/inset; box dimensions use `--ds-size-*`.

## Component tier (per-component theming hooks)


# Design System — theming (brand: meridian-atlas-ui)
> GENERATED by @ds/context — DO NOT EDIT. Source hash sha256:b95446232cde065d. Regenerate: pnpm --filter @ds/context build

White-labeling is a token-and-pipeline problem, not a component problem. A customer theme is a data file, never a fork.

## The three-tier token model

1. **Brand tier** (`brands/<name>.json`) — raw values only: palette ramps (`palette.{neutral,primary,…}.{50…950}`), typefaces, type scale (base + ratio), radius scale, space base, elevation, logo assets. This is the ONLY tier a customer theme may replace.
2. **Semantic tier** (`--ds-{category}-{concept}[-{variant}][-{state}]`) — intent-named mappings onto brand ramp positions (`--ds-color-surface-raised`, never `--ds-blue-500`). Usage sites reference this tier. Customers do not edit mappings; semantic overrides are a separate, allowlisted layer.
3. **Component tier** (`--ds-<component>-*`) — per-component hooks consumed by that component's CSS. The per-component customer override surface.

Gap vs space steps: the `--ds-space-gap-{sm,md,lg}` trio (tops out at `gap-lg`) is for intra-component rhythm (icon-to-label, control clusters, sibling gaps); larger section- and region-level separation uses the plain space steps (`--ds-space-5` and up).

## Brand-file mechanics

A customer engagement produces one `brands/<customer>.json` in the same shape as the neutral core (`brands/default.json`): raw ramps, no intent. The pipeline then rebuilds everything: tokens-build resolves semantic + component tiers against the brand file, validates EVERY color mapping for WCAG 2.2 AA contrast (current brand: 14 failures across 35 audited pairs), regenerates the registries, and re-runs this context compiler with `--brand <customer>` so llms.txt, docs, skills, editor rules, and the auditor agent all reflect the customer's resolved values. Zero component code changes for standard engagements.

## Allowlisted extension points (everything else is closed)

Machine contract: `extension-points.json` in this bundle (ADR-006) — the authoritative allowlist.

1. **Brand-tier token file** — replace raw ramp values wholesale.
2. **Semantic overrides** — a separate, explicitly-allowlisted override layer applied at intake (contrast-validated like everything else).
3. **Component-tier hooks** — override per-component custom properties:
4. **Composition + `className`** — every component accepts a plain-string `className` appended after its own classes; compose components and plain elements for layout.

## Not extension points (negative rules apply)

- Semantic-tier intent mappings (customer files replace values, never mappings).
- Component CSS or component source — never fork.
- Raw palette scales at usage sites (`--ds-blue-500` does not exist publicly).
- Another component's hooks (overriding Alert must never restyle Badge).
- Inline `style` props — intentionally not supported; use tokens in CSS.


# Design System — migration (brand: meridian-atlas-ui)
> GENERATED by @ds/context — DO NOT EDIT. Source hash sha256:b95446232cde065d. Regenerate: pnpm --filter @ds/context build

> Your training data about this design system is stale or empty. This system is closed-world: if a component or token is not in the registry, it does not exist. Do not adapt patterns from Chakra, MUI, Ant, or shadcn.

This slice maps habits from raw HTML/CSS, Tailwind, and other design systems onto this system. It is compiled from the living negative-rule catalog — every rule below was observed or anticipated as a real agent hallucination.

## From Tailwind / utility CSS

- Utility classes are not part of this system: replace `className="p-4 rounded-lg text-gray-600"` with a CSS Module class consuming tokens (`padding: var(--ds-space-4); border-radius: var(--ds-radius-lg); color: var(--ds-color-text-muted);`).
- Tailwind's spacing-scale-for-everything habit does not transfer: space tokens are only legal in margin/padding/gap/inset; widths and heights use `--ds-size-*` (e.g. `--ds-size-control-md`).
- Color utilities map to intent tokens, not hue scales: `text-gray-600` → `var(--ds-color-text-secondary)` or `-muted` by intent, never a raw scale.

## From Chakra / MUI / Ant / shadcn

- Layout primitives (`Box`, `Stack`, `Container`, `Flex`, `Grid`, `Spacer`) and typography components (`Heading`, `Text`) do not exist here — intentionally. Use plain semantic HTML plus CSS with tokens. (Exception to hand-rolled headings: Dialog renders its own title from its required `title` prop — never add a heading element to name a dialog.)
- Theme-object styling (`sx`, `css` props, styled()) does not exist; components accept `className` only, and inline `style` is intentionally unsupported.
- Import from the single entry point `@ds/react`; deep dist paths are not public API.

## From raw HTML / hand-rolled CSS

- Replace hex/rgb literals with intent tokens; the validator rejects hard-coded values in component CSS.
- Replace `:hover`/`:focus-visible`/`:disabled` pseudo-classes with react-aria data attributes (`[data-hovered]`, `[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`) when styling this system's components.
- Do not hand-roll focus traps, keyboard navigation, or ARIA — the components ship it (react-aria-components).

## The negative-rule catalog (wrong → right)

### NR-001 Layout primitives do not exist
- Wrong: `<Box p={4}>`, `<Stack gap="md">`, `<Container>`, `<Flex>`, `<Grid>`, `<Spacer>`
- Right: plain elements + CSS with space tokens: `display:flex; gap: var(--ds-space-gap-md)`
- Why: most-hallucinated components industry-wide; intentionally not shipped.

### NR-002 Typography components do not exist
- Wrong: `<Heading level={2}>`, `<Text size="sm">`
- Right: semantic HTML (`<h2>`, `<p>`) with `var(--ds-text-size-*)` / `var(--ds-text-weight-*)`

### NR-003 Raw color scales are not public tokens
- Wrong: `var(--ds-blue-500)`, `var(--ds-palette-primary-600)`, hex literals
- Right: intent tokens: `var(--ds-color-accent-default)`, `var(--ds-color-text-primary)`

### NR-004 Tailwind/utility classes are not part of this system
- Wrong: `className="p-4 rounded-lg text-gray-600"`
- Right: CSS Module class consuming `--ds-*` tokens

### NR-005 Do not import from deep paths
- Wrong: `import Button from '@ds/react/dist/Button'`
- Right: `import { Button } from '@ds/react'` — the only public entry point

### NR-006 Space tokens are not sizes
- Wrong: `inline-size: var(--ds-space-4)`, `height: var(--ds-space-6)`
- Right: size tokens for boxes: `var(--ds-size-control-md)`, `var(--ds-size-icon-md)`; space tokens only in margin/padding/gap/inset
- Why: spacing scales pattern-match to sizing in Tailwind-trained output; breaks independently-themable density.

### NR-007 There is no `on-status` text token
- Wrong: `var(--ds-color-text-on-danger)`, `var(--ds-color-status-danger-on)`
- Right: `var(--ds-color-text-inverse)` on solid status fills — and only pairs present in registries/contrast-report.json
- Why: `on-accent` exists, so agents extrapolate `on-<anything>`; the extrapolated names are fabricated.

### NR-008 Component-tier tokens belong to their component only
- Wrong: `background: var(--ds-alert-surface-info)` inside Badge.module.css
- Right: Badge uses `--ds-badge-*` or semantic-tier tokens
- Why: cross-component borrowing couples theming hooks; overriding Alert would silently restyle Badge.

### NR-009 State selectors are RAC data attributes, not pseudo-classes
- Wrong: `.button:hover`, `.tab:focus-visible`, `.field input:disabled`
- Right: `.button[data-hovered]`, `.tab[data-focus-visible]`, `[data-disabled]`
- Why: pseudo-classes fire on touch emulation and on disabled elements; react-aria-components normalizes interaction state.

### NR-010 The base class is the lowercased component name
- Wrong: `.root`, `.wrapper`, `.container` as the component's base CSS class; `.progress-bar` (kebab-casing a CamelCase name)
- Right: `.button`, `.card`, `.alert`, `.progressbar` — the name lowercased LITERALLY, no separators — composed as `[styles.<name>, styles[variant], styles[size], className]`
- Why: one canon keeps tests and docgen grep-stable across the component set. Scope: applies to `@ds/react` components; consumer application code follows its own local convention.

### NR-011 CSS-module classes are a closed world too
- Wrong: `className={styles.message}` when the component's .module.css defines no `.message`
- Right: reference only classes that exist in the component's own .module.css; add the rule before the reference
- Why: undefined module lookups fail silently (the className vanishes at runtime); pattern-matched from design systems whose components have differently-named parts.

### NR-012 Class z-index does not reach RAC-positioned overlays
- Wrong: `.popover { z-index: var(--ds-z-dropdown); }` expecting it to control stacking
- Right: pass `style={{ zIndex: 'var(--ds-z-dropdown)' }}` on the RAC Popover/Tooltip element — react-aria sets inline `zIndex: 100000`, and only a user style merged after it wins
- Why: inline style beats any class rule; the token silently never applies.

### NR-013 Motion must be gated; movement always
- Wrong: `@keyframes` / transform·translate·rotate·scale transitions with no `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block
- Right: every movement animation gets an `animation: none` / `transition: none` override under the reduced-motion media query; color/border/shadow-only transitions are exempt
- Why: WCAG 2.3.3 applies to movement; an ungated entry animation ships motion to users who opted out.

## Migration workflow

1. Enumerate the closed world: read `registries/components-index.json` and `registries/tokens-index.json` (or llms-components.txt / llms-tokens.txt).
2. Map each legacy element/class to a registry component or to plain HTML + tokens, using the pairs above.
3. Port screen by screen; never carry over utility classes, inline styles, or fabricated components.
4. Gate every ported screen on the deterministic gauntlet: `pnpm validate` (typecheck → lint → build → test/a11y → registry check).
